build_dataset_builder: build a YesNo dataset builder that downloads 60 Hebrew yes/no wav files and yields audio examples with labels
create_dataset_info: create a dataset info object with audio features, sequence labels, and filename metadata for the YesNo dataset
generate_examples: generate examples from wav files by parsing filenames into yes/no label sequences
split_generators: split generators that download and extract the YesNo dataset archive into a single train split
review_yesno_class: review the YesNo class that extends GeneratorBasedBuilder for a Hebrew yes/no audio dataset
